discoveryPolicy.public: Traverse each official landing page and its current linked exam artifacts for the selected academic scope.
discoveryPolicy.authenticated: An authorized source agent enumerates accessible courses in the selected year/quarter, reads course introductions and assessment notices in forums/pages/calendars, and adds verified source URLs before extracting candidates.
discoveryPolicy.identity: Verify the full course code and class suffix from the actual course identity; resolve syllabus offering identity only when evidenced.
discoveryPolicy.coverage: Record reviewed courses, inaccessible sources, and unresolved candidates. Listed LMS URLs are verified sources, not a complete inventory of all courses.
discoveryPolicy.publication: Never delete existing entries because discovery or authenticated access was incomplete.
